title: Nexus AI Trace Item
description: Machine-readable contract for a single Nexus AI audit Trace item, per docs/ai-sdlc-factory/07-pipeline-contract-standard.md section 12 (Trace Contract). A Trace item is operation history (islem gecmisi) that proves the production path of evidence (K-008: Evidence = decision proof; Trace = operation history; the two are grouped under Audit but kept distinct). Documentation/blueprint only; no runtime code. LOCKED: no 'plugin' concept anywhere (K-001).

allOf.$comment: LOCKED K-001: the plugin concept is cancelled and must never appear. Defense-in-depth: additionalProperties:false already rejects unknown keys, and this clause makes the prohibition explicit and self-documenting.

trace_id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for this trace item.

type.description: Trace category in snake_case. Canonical kinds (doc 06 section 10): agent_invocation, sub_agent_invocation, skill_activation, tool_call, handoff_event, policy_evaluation, rework_route. Stage contracts also use descriptive composite names such as <stage>_stage_trace, <skill>_skill_activation_trace, <tool>_tool_trace, <gate>_gate_decision_trace. This is a Trace type, never an Evidence type (Evidence != Trace).

actor.description: The entity that performed the action being traced (e.g. a pipeline Agent role, a sub-agent, the team_lead, or a Core Ability such as Supervisor when it routes). Free-form string; this is NOT owner_agent and carries no owner/authorship semantics. owner_agent is a stage_contract field and does not exist on a trace item, so the 'Core Ability must never be owner_agent' rule (K-003/K-004) is not enforced here. See open_questions.

action.description: What the actor did (e.g. invoked, activated, called, evaluated, handed_off, routed_rework). Plain string description of the traced operation.

related_pipeline.description: pipeline_id this trace belongs to (e.g. the SDLC pipeline). Null if not bound to a specific pipeline.

related_run.description: run_id of the pipeline run this trace belongs to. Null if not bound to a specific run.

related_stage.description: stage_id this trace occurred within. Null if not stage-scoped.

related_skill.description: Skill from the shared registry that this trace activated, if any (Skill != Tool). Null when no skill is involved. Canonical skills: prism, verification-loop, sentinel, llm-council, fmea, adr-builder, gap-audit, prompt-fidelity, calibrate, refraction, fermi-decompose, bayesian-update.

related_tool.description: Tool from the shared registry that this trace called, if any (Tool != Skill; side-effect tools imply governance + trace). Null when no tool is involved.

related_core_ability.description: The Core Ability involved in this trace, if any. LOCKED closed set (K-003): Supervisor, Coder, Vision, Audio, Creative, Memory, Web, OS. A Core Ability is NOT an agent and NOT a team member; it may be referenced here as a capability layer only. Null when no Core Ability is involved.

input_refs.description: References to inputs consumed by this operation (artifact ids, evidence ids, or other trace ids). Empty array if none.

output_refs.description: References to outputs produced by this operation (artifact ids, evidence ids, or other trace ids). Empty array if none. Note: a trace records the production path; the evidence it produced lives in Evidence items (Evidence != Trace).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the traced operation.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp of when the traced operation occurred.
